_comment: World B usage-aware cascade. Routing policy lives in routing-policy.json; this file supplies the executable cascade classes. A chunk's executor intent maps to a class here; cascade-dispatch.sh walks that class's role ladder, resolves roles per host via harness-profile.json, checks live headroom (usage-probe.sh) + the quality_floor, dispatches the best available rung, and on a cap error fires the Airlift Tier-1 checkpoint and DESCENDS. OpenRouter mechanical-agent routing in dm-review reads the same policy; DeepSeek names are model slugs, never a separate provider.

class_from_kind._comment: Coding kind -> cascade class. Config/docs go OpenRouter-primary; logic, ui, and integration go Codex-primary. Claude native is an authorization-gated LAST-RESORT coding rung below both external rails (see policy._comment_native_fallback).

quality_rank._comment: Global model->score; enforces quality_floor regardless of which role surfaced the model. Higher = better. Bare GPT names are native Codex identities. Terra and Luna OpenRouter slugs are used only by explicitly policy-routed review/direct calls, outside the host fallback ladder.
quality_rank._comment_gpt56: GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna, GA 2026-07-09) supersedes GPT-5.5. These bare names remain on the native Codex subscription rail.
quality_rank._comment_codex_mini: gpt-5.1-codex-mini keeps a rank so a stray re-add scores above the codex floor rather than silently resolving to 0, but it appears in NO ladder: `codex exec --model gpt-5.1-codex-mini` returns HTTP 400 'not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account', and the codex host runs on the ChatGPT sub. Do not re-add it to harness-profile.json.
quality_rank._comment_kimi_k3: Kimi K3 (moonshotai/kimi-k3) is the quality-first OpenRouter head for bulk analysis and the supplementary security lens. Terra is its quality backup; Luna is the economical first rung for lightweight mechanical work. The checked-in rank is policy, while live availability, endpoint identity, price, and benchmark observations require a fresh MCP receipt. The current wrapper is text-only. PRIVACY: provider privacy is demoted; OPENROUTER_ZDR=1 remains opt-in.

codex._comment: Primary executor = Codex for logic, UI, and integration. When Codex caps, descend through agentic OpenRouter, then the authorization-gated native judgment rung, then wrapper models.

openrouter._comment: Primary executor = OpenRouter for config/docs/mechanical logic. Codex is the trusted coding fallback, then the authorization-gated native judgment rung, then wrapper models.

policy._comment_headroom: Treat a sub/native rail as exhausted once probed remaining quota drops below this -- hand off BEFORE the hard wall (mirrors Airlift's early-warning trip).
policy._comment_reentry: When an exhausted sub rail's resets_at passes it re-enters at its original ladder position (flat-rate and free again -- prefer quality).
policy._comment_subscriptions: Coding rails: Codex Pro 20x is the active flat-rate workhorse, with a named 5x profile; OpenRouter carries external agentic and mechanical work. Claude Pro sits below both as an authorization-gated native last-resort coding rung and is unselectable without a live human grant.
policy._comment_fable: Fable 5 keeps its quality score for research, judgment, and review lanes. Opus heads the authorization-gated native_judgment coding rung; Fable is routed explicitly for adversarial plan review rather than by ladder descent.
policy._comment_native_fallback: 2026-08-08 user directive (Trav): user judgment overrides written routing policy. native_judgment is an authorization-gated executable coding rung, placed BELOW premium_sub and openrouter_exec in every class so it can fire only when both external rails are unavailable and a live, time-boxed human authorization permits it. Rationale: the automated OpenRouter rail fails closed on hosts without /usr/local/bin/workflow-authority, so a capped Codex sub previously produced a total execution deadlock (2026-08-08 zero-chunk BLOCKED run). Every dispatch on this rung is a target variance and must be receipted (routing-policy targets.enforcement.varianceReceiptRequired). Without a valid authorization the cascade behaves exactly as if the rung were absent and reports the deadlock honestly instead of silently routing coding work to Claude. Revisit when the broker lands (R3) and the interim macOS authorization retires.
policy._comment_native_authorization: A human may grant a bounded native_judgment window for one repository and run. Only dispatches before the explicit epoch-seconds expiry may select the rung; every selected dispatch is a target variance and emits authorization evidence requiring a variance receipt. An absent, expired, malformed, or scope-mismatched authorization makes the rung unselectable. The gate always fails closed and never defaults open, including during dry runs.
policy._comment_native_host_constraint: GPT-5.6 Sol is native Codex only and remains the preferred coding head. Terra and Luna OpenRouter calls are explicit policy-routed review/direct workloads rather than replacements in the host fallback ladder. Claude aliases retained in harness-profile native_judgment are native Claude compatibility metadata for explicit non-coding workflows; coding cascades may reference that role only through the fail-closed human authorization gate.
policy.privacy: DEMOTED (2026-07-18, user directive): model selection priority is Quality > Price > Speed > Provider privacy. OPENROUTER_ZDR is OPT-IN, never a default pin -- Chinese first-party hosting (Moonshot/DeepSeek/Z.AI) is acceptable by default. Set OPENROUTER_ZDR=1 per-call only for genuinely sensitive material (client code under NDA, credentials-adjacent diffs); when set, a model with no eligible ZDR provider (e.g. moonshotai/kimi-k3 pre-weights) is a per-model failure and the ladder walks on.
policy._comment_headroom_unknown: usage-probe state 'unknown' is treated as HAS-headroom: dispatch plus reactive cap detection is preferred over falsely skipping a healthy Codex or OpenRouter rail.
policy._comment_agentic_seam: openrouter_exec is the agentic OpenRouter rung for config/docs/mechanical-logic. Wrapper rungs (cheap_api/frontier_api) remain single-turn analysis/text generation and are still invalid for complex logic/ui/integration implementation.
